title: Weakly etale algebras over a field
statement:
If $k$ is a field and $B/k$ is weakly etale
[def-weil-pbc-ind-etale-algebra], every finitely generated $k$-subalgebra of
$B$ is finite etale. In particular $B$ is ind-etale, is reduced, and all its
residue fields are separable algebraic over $k$.

proof.text: Use the source theorem `Algebra.WeaklyEtale.indEtale_field` to install the ind-etale structure on B. Use `Algebra.WeaklyEtale.etale_of_fg` for each finitely generated subalgebra; its etale structure is formally unramified, and finite type plus the field-module basis gives module finiteness by `Algebra.FormallyUnramified.finite_of_free`. The absolutely-flat structure obtained from `Algebra.WeaklyEtale.flat_lmul'` gives reducedness by its Mathlib instance. Finally `Algebra.IndEtale.isSeparable_residueField_of_field` gives separability of each residue field, and `Algebra.IsSeparable.isAlgebraic` gives algebraicity.
